note: CB-D1/D2/D3: parsers/code/dart/src/lib.rs mints no node for a constructor, a factory or an operator (their bodies' calls are credited to the CLASS), none for an abstract member (only a method with a body is read), and keeps enum constants as names only. DECISION: the unnamed constructor is METHOD `<Class>::<Class>` (the Java / C# constructor qname), a named constructor or factory `C.name` is METHOD `<Class>::name` (it is called as `C.name(...)`, so `Money.zero()` binds through class_methods), an operator is METHOD `<Class>::operator<op>` (`operator+`, `operator[]=`). Measured on HEAD 2170ff8: CALLS lib::src::money::Money -> round2 is the only edge out of the class.

expect_edges.note: enum constant under its ENUM (the Rust / TypeScript / Java enum-member edge)

forbid.note: a CLASS makes no calls; its members do
